purpose: Positive fixture of a Circular CLI Session 50 of several --gbk files: the released writer binds the three files as one composite c_gb (components in argv order) and commits one record input per file (record-1:1, record-1:2, record-2, record-3). The move to drawings makes one File card per file (circularSources, uids record-1..3).
writer: gbdraw circular --session_output (CLI sidecar) from release tag v0.14.5 (git archive v0.14.5 gbdraw, on PYTHONPATH), run in a directory holding copies of the three inputs
command: python -P -c 'from gbdraw.cli import main; main()' circular --gbk web_batch_two_records.gb regex_rules.gb feature_location_search.gb --multi_record_canvas -o cli-circular-three-gbk -f svg --session_output cli-circular-three-gbk.gbdraw-session.json
values: webFiles.bindings.c_gb {kind: composite, components: record-1-genbank, record-3-genbank, record-4-genbank}; renderRequest.records recordKey record-1:1, record-1:2 (source record-1-genbank), record-2 (record-3-genbank), record-3 (record-4-genbank); cliInvocation.fileBindings slots files.c_gb.components[0..2]
